purpose: Verifies an in-toto SLSA provenance statement: validates _type (in-toto.io/Statement) and predicateType (slsa.dev/provenance), checks subject SHA-256 digest against caller-supplied artifact_digest_sha256, asserts builder.id present via runDetails.builder.id or predicate.builder.id, reports claimed_build_level 0-3. Middle stage of sbom-provenance-attestation chain.
